verdict.rationale: Maritime's Computers feature documents a persistent Linux desktop (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) for each end user, driven by your model. The changelog adds screenshot, mouse and keyboard control plus a live view you can take over, and scoped Computers keys gate access to it. The full-desktop half of the story is clearly documented, but the changelog's wording ("are getting") suggests the feature is newly rolling out. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless-browser automation (e.g. Playwright or Puppeteer inside agent containers), detailed desktop API docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
